question: Point out the correct answer regarding the essential criteria to be able to carry out a cadaveric kidney transplant:

options.opa: ABO group compatibility and negative cross-match (recipient serum does not react against donor T lymphocytes).
options.opb: Donor-receptor identity in the histocompatibility antigen DR.
options.opc: Absence of cytotoxic antibodies in the receptor.
options.opd: The donor must be less than 65 years of age.
